issue_context.title: API doc should use the field name in description
issue_context.body:
### What happened?

Currently we have inconsistency in most of the API where the field name should be used in description so the generated docs match the API fields people actually set. 
e.g. 
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/367f01f62d1a6ca149c317f97a958dd5c6e74af1/staging/src/k8s.io/api/admission/v1/types.go#L41
`uid` should be used instead of `UID` so it's shown properly in generated docs.


### What did you expect to happen?

Inside https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/api/openapi-spec/swagger.json description, the field name should reflect the real field name people actually set.

The work could be divided based on API group. 

### Steps

1. Modify the godoc in the versioned types.go file(s) for the appropriate API group to use the JSON name when referring to API fields. Create a commit with these changes.
2. Run `make update` to regenerate API documentation files (this will generate updates to proto files, generated go files, and openapi json files) (or open a PR with just the types.go changes and update the generated files using the instructions at https://www.kubernetes.dev/blog/2022/03/15/k8s-triage-bot-helper-ci-job/#using-the-short-term-solution). Create a second commit with these changes.

### API groups

- admissionregistration.k8s.io | v1 - @bhavyastar
- apiextensions.k8s.io | v1 - @ShivamTyagi12345 (located within staging/src/k8s.io/apiextensions-apiserver/pkg/apis/apiextensions/v*/types*.go)
- apiregistration.k8s.io | v1 - @ShivamTyagi12345 (located within staging/src/k8s.io/kube-aggregator/pkg/apis/apiregistration/v*/types.go) - https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/113603
